prompt: Generate 25 distinct tasks in accessibility improvements to public events. Batch 17/20.

tasks.topic: Install tactile floor paths and braille signage for main hallways at downtown convention center before spring expo
Pilot real-time ASL interpretation service for keynote sessions at regional arts festival using on-stage interpreters
Add high-contrast, large-print directional banners for outdoor food fair with weather-resistant materials
Deploy loaner mobility scooters and charging stations at city marathon spectator zones along three-mile stretch
Introduce quiet rooms with dim lighting and soft seating during weekend comic convention to reduce sensory overload
Implement captioned live-stream for community town hall and archive recordings with transcripts in event portal
Provide scent-free sections and notify vendors to use unscented products for indoor craft market
Roll out accessible ticketing flow with screen-reader labels and keyboard navigation for annual film festival website
Create wheelchair-accessible viewing platforms at outdoor concert main stage with companion seating and shade
Develop multilingual audio guides with easy-to-use handheld devices for museum night event
Install portable induction loop systems at workshop rooms for hearing aid users during tech summit
Publish detailed step-free routes and elevator locations in downloadable venue maps for science expo
Offer large-print and braille programs for orchestra performance with advance pickup and onsite request options
Test tactile maps and QR-linked audio descriptions for heritage site open day visitor flow
Set up accessible shuttle service with ramp-equipped vans between parking lot and county fair entrance
Provide seating with armrests and varied heights across lobby areas for senior-friendly wellness fair
Add visual alarm strobes synchronized with PA announcements in exhibit halls for safety alerts
Train volunteers on disability etiquette and assistance protocols before neighborhood street festival kickoff
Implement stroller and wheelchair-friendly security screening lanes with wider tables at stadium entry
Launch text-to-speech enabled event app with offline schedules and customizable font sizes for book fair
Reserve service animal relief areas with signage and waste stations near main entrances for pet policy clarity
Provide shade canopies and hydration stations along accessible pathways for summer outdoor marketplace
Pilot color communication badges to indicate sensory preferences and interaction comfort at gaming convention
Distribute pre-event accessibility surveys and follow-up feedback forms to refine inclusive practices at citywide parade
Add curb ramps and temporary matting over grass to create stable routes between booths at community picnic
